name: 4-Chlorodiazepam
summary: A benzodiazepine derivative of Diazepam, yet lacks affinity for GABA(a) receptors, yet is a sedative that has pro-convulsant effects. At lower doses it has been shown to be neuroprotective.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Ro5-4864 was found to be a potent ligand for the "peripheral benzodiazepine receptor", later renamed to mitochondrial translocator protein 18kDa (TSPO).

uses.text: Despite its convulsant effects, at lower doses Ro5-4864 has proved to be neuroprotective and has become widely used for research into the role of the TSPO protein in neurotoxicity.
